Parallel returns relevant excerpts optimized for LLMs, replacing multiple keyword searches with a single call for broad or complex queries.

Part of [`seek web`](seek-web.md).

## Usage

```text
seek web parallel [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Search query |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-n, --num <number>` | Max results | `10` |
| `-c, --chars <number>` | Max chars per result excerpt | `1500` |
| `--objective <text>` | Objective passed to the ranker (defaults to the query) |  |
| `--mode <name>` | Search mode: basic \| advanced |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek web parallel` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek web parallel --help`:

```text

Parallel returns relevant excerpts optimized for LLMs, replacing multiple
keyword searches with a single call for broad or complex queries.

Arguments:

Options:

  -c, --chars <number>  Max chars per result excerpt (default: 1500)
  --objective <text>    Objective passed to the ranker (defaults to the query)
  --mode <name>         Search mode: basic | advanced
  --json                Emit raw JSON response
  -h, --help            display help for command
```
